legibility.note: All text is clearly readable against the chalkboard background, despite the chalk-style font. The watermark text "2manybeans" is also legible.

bounds.note: The top line of text "Guatemala Huehuetenango La Libertad Finca" slightly overlaps the top wooden frame of the chalkboard.

hierarchy.note: While the first line is the largest, the visual difference in size between the first line (bean name) and the second line (company/origin/process) is not strong enough to establish clear hierarchy, making the primary name less prominent than it could be.

spacing.note: The vertical spacing between the two main title lines is a bit tight. Also, the gap between the horizontal rule and the recipe parameters (RATIO/BLOOM) is excessively large, creating a disconnect.

balance.note: The entire block of text is positioned too high on the chalkboard, leaving a disproportionately large empty space towards the bottom of the chalkboard above Ruphus, leading to poor vertical balance.

suggestions: Adjust the 'top' CSS property of the main text content container on the chalkboard from its current position (e.g., 60px from the chalkboard top) to 85px to move the entire text block down by 25px.
Increase font-size of the primary title "Guatemala Huehuetenango La Libertad Finca" from its current size (e.g., 30px) to 38px.
Decrease font-size of the secondary title "George Howell Coffee Company · Guatemala · Honey" from its current size (e.g., 24px) to 20px.

Increase line-height for the top two title text elements ("Guatemala Huehuetenango La Libertad Finca" and "George Howell Coffee Company · Guatemala · Honey") from its current value (e.g., 1.2em) to 1.4em.
Decrease the margin-bottom of the horizontal rule from its current value (e.g., 30px) to 15px, to reduce the gap between the rule and the recipe parameters.
